title: Screening

firstUse.title: Decide which papers belong in your review
firstUse.text: Bring papers from searches, collections or your own files, set your criteria, and screen them yourself, with colleagues, with AI models, or with any mix of the three.

papersHelp.title: Where the papers stand
papersHelp.text: Each bar splits a screening's papers by where they stand now. Press a part of the bar to see those papers.

discussion.title: Discussion
discussion.about: {models, select, true {Reviewers and the person who settles conflicts talk a paper over here, with everyone on it or with one person. A line to one person is a question, and it stays on their Screening list until they answer. A model can't be asked. Press one of its marks in the table for the passage it read.} other {Reviewers and the person who settles conflicts talk a paper over here, with everyone on it or with one person. A line to one person is a question, and it stays on their Screening list until they answer.}}
discussion.blind: This screening hides what is written about a paper from a reviewer only while the paper still waits for that reviewer's own vote.
discussion.shut: Reviewers talk a paper over here. It stays out of sight so it can't sway your vote.

discussion.forAll: Everyone who can see this paper's votes reads it. Pick a name to ask one person a question.
